title: Bir İmparatorluğun Gerçek Hikâyesi
visualStyle: Authentic 1970s Istanbul documentary photograph, shot on grainy Kodak Tri-X black and white film, natural available light, candid and unposed, slightly soft focus, archival print texture, no text, no watermark.

cast.hasan: a Turkish man in his late twenties in 1974, thick black moustache, short wavy dark hair, white cotton shirt with rolled sleeves
cast.nermin: a Turkish woman in her early thirties in 1974, dark hair tied in a low bun, simple patterned cotton dress, kind but tired eyes

imagePrompts: Extreme close-up of weathered hands counting a few old coins on the worn wooden counter of a street food cart

imagePrompts.prompt: Extreme close-up of the man's eyes and moustache, intense gaze straight ahead, half of his face in deep shadow

imagePrompts: Close-up of a dented copper pot on a street food cart, thick steam rising into cold morning air
Close-up of a woman's hands writing with a fountain pen in an old notebook, the handwriting blurred and illegible, lit by a bare bulb
The long shadow of a walking man thrown across a cobbled alley wall at night by a streetlamp, the man himself out of frame, only his shadow visible
An open, empty wooden kitchen drawer lit by a sharp shaft of cold moonlight from a window, a single torn corner of paper left inside, clearly visible, strong contrast
scenes.say: [whispers] Bir tarif... Bir sokak... [dramatic] Ve bir ihanet.

scenes.title: Gerçek Hikâyesi
scenes.imagePrompt: The man stands in the middle of a crowded Istanbul street in 1974, looking into the camera, the Galata tower rising far behind him, crowds and an old tram blurred around him
scenes.sound: busy 1970s Istanbul street, distant tram bell, crowd murmur, faint street vendors calling

scenes.label: Şube
scenes.say: [confident] Bugün, otuz sekiz binden fazla şubesi var.

scenes.text: Ama her şey tek bir sokak arabasıyla başladı
scenes.imagePrompt: Wide shot of the man standing beside his small wooden street food cart on the far left of a narrow cobbled street, long evening shadows, empty street stretching away to the right
scenes.sound: quiet cobbled back street at dusk, pigeons, distant seagulls, a wooden cart wheel creaking
scenes.say: [curious] Ama her şey... tek bir sokak arabasıyla başladı.

scenes.imagePrompt: Close portrait of the man smiling at his cart, holding a paper cone of food out to a customer
imagePrompts: An old yellowed sheet of paper with faded, blurred, illegible handwritten ink notes, lying on a worn wooden kitchen table beside a tin cup, close up
scenes.name: Hasan Kervan
scenes.sound: food sizzling in a pan on a street cart, paper rustling, soft street chatter
scenes.say: [warmly] Adı Hasan Kervan'dı. Bin dokuz yüz yetmiş dörtte, elinde tek bir tarifle yola çıktı.

scenes.imagePrompt: The woman sitting on the right side of a small kitchen table, writing carefully in a notebook under a single bare hanging bulb at night, dark empty kitchen around her
scenes.name: Nermin Aydın
scenes.sound: silent kitchen at night, a bare lightbulb buzzing, pen scratching on paper, an old clock ticking faintly
scenes.say: [quietly] Ama o tarifi... aslında o yazmamıştı.

scenes.imagePrompt: The silhouette of a man slipping out of a doorway at night holding folded papers against his chest, strongly backlit by a bright streetlamp and fog behind him, his face not visible
scenes.sound: empty street at night, a distant dog barking, a door closing softly
scenes.say: [slowly] Ve o tarif... bir gece... [dramatic] çalındı.

scenes.imagePrompt: The woman sitting alone by a window on the left of the frame, looking out at the rain, raindrops on the glass
scenes.caption: Tek kuruş almadı
scenes.sound: steady rain on a window pane, soft distant thunder

scenes.text: Bu, o tarifin bedelini ödeyenlerin hikâyesi
scenes.imagePrompt: An empty wooden street food cart abandoned on a wet cobbled street at night under a single streetlamp
scenes.sound: light rain on wet cobblestones, a lonely streetlamp humming
scenes.say: [softly] Bu... o tarifin bedelini ödeyenlerin hikâyesi.
